source.title: Signal: Selective Interaction and Global-local Alignment for Multi-Modal Object Re-Identification

acceptance: A verified complete F1-initialized model must strictly exceed the literal published value for every metric reported for that dataset. Compare unrounded actual model metrics; equality is not exceeding.
aspiration: Aim for approximately +1 percentage point in mAP and Rank-1. This is separate from strict paper-exceeding acceptance.
vehicle_rank5_rank10: Not reported in Signal Table 2; retain our measured values as supplementary results without inventing paper thresholds.
local_signal_role: Controlled same-protocol diagnostics only. Existing local-Signal deltas/repair-harm records remain historical evidence and do not define the user goal.
